emblem.title: Student Union Emblem
emblem.imgAlt: Emblem of Demonstration School of University of Phayao Student Union
emblem.descriptionText: The official emblem features a black seven-tiered candlestick (Sattaphan) standing prominently against a golden-yellow circular background symbolizing the sun. At the base of the candlestick sit the purple Thai initials "มพ" beneath the white English lettering "STUDENT UNION". Surrounding the centerpiece is a black circular border inscribed with "Demonstration School . University of Phayao" in white, anchored at the bottom by a curved white ribbon bearing the Thai title "องค์การนักเรียน" in black.

authority.title: Powers & Duties of the Student Union
authority.subtitle: Pursuant to the Demonstration School, University of Phayao Announcement on the Student Union, B.E. 2569 (2026)
authority.section1Title: Powers and Duties of the Student Union are as follows

duties.text: Safeguard the collective interests and legitimate rights of students concerning student affairs.
Administer Student Union activities in accordance with declared policies, provided they do not conflict with school regulations, rules, announcements, or policies.
Perform other duties as assigned by the school.

authority.section2Title: The Student Union shall conduct itself as follows

guidelines.text: Uphold the collective interests and welfare of the student body.
Maintain effectiveness in organizing and advancing student activities.
Adhere faithfully to the principles of democratic governance.
Strictly observe all school regulations, rules, announcements, orders, and policies.
Promote co-curricular activities reflecting school student identity while preserving, nurturing, reviving, and creatively advancing national arts and culture.
Act with integrity, honesty, and transparency in administration while remaining eager to learn and proactive.
Demonstrate responsible leadership as well as good followership.
Enhance and uphold the reputation and honor of the school.
